identity.title: CVE-2026-69154
identity.description: The Coder VS Code extension opens Coder workspaces in VS Code with a single click. From 0.1.20 until 1.14.6, a malicious repository can provide .vscode/settings.json values for security-sensitive Coder settings because the extension permits workspace and folder scope to override those settings. Values such as coder.headerCommand and coder.tlsCertRefreshCommand are later executed as shell commands, while other affected settings can redirect the Coder CLI binary or download source, inject CLI or SSH flags, replace TLS material, disable TLS verification, or change identity and credential-storage behavior. A victim with the extension installed must open the malicious workspace or repository; when the extension activates, attacker-controlled commands can run with the victim user's privileges. The issue also affects untrusted workspaces because the extension declares untrusted-workspace support without preventing consumption of the workspace-controlled settings. This issue is fixed in version 1.14.6.

identity.title: CVE-2026-83816
identity.description: CodeWhale is a DeepSeek and MiMo coding agent for the terminal. Prior to 0.9.0, the ExecShellTool::approval_requirement_for path used is_parallel_readonly_command to downgrade commands to automatic approval based on a flag-stripped command allowlist. The allowlist treated fd, rg, and git grep as read-only even when fd -x or fd --exec, rg --pre, or git grep --open-files-in-pager selected an external program. registered_tool_approval_required returned without displaying a prompt for that automatic classification, and the later command-safety check also treated the base utilities as safe. identity.title: CVE-2026-102448
identity.description: A vulnerability has been identified in Rexroth IndraWorks. This flaw allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the user’s system by parsing a manipulated file, because the file parser fails to properly sanitize the path name(s) or references embedded in the manipulated file. Exploitation requires user interaction, specifically opening a specially crafted file, which then causes the application to traverse outside the target directory and to write files in unauthorized locations, eventually enabling Remote Code Execution (RCE). This can lead to a complete compromise of the system running Rexroth IndraWorks.

barriers.summary: local, privileges: NONE, user interaction: REQUIRED

cwe_names.CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

_relevance.reason: barrier_gate: attack vector LOCAL, no exploitation signal

identity.title: CVE-2026-124672
identity.description: The Burst Statistics WordPress plugin before 3.7.5 does not verify that a request is actually being routed to its own REST API before unloading every other active plugin for that request, allowing unauthenticated attackers to have requests processed with other plugins' protections (such as REST access restrictions, hidden login pages and two-factor authentication) switched off, and to cause other plugins' scheduled tasks to be discarded.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE
